name: The Sunflower Swap
prompt: Stand broad flat solar discs on short yellow necks around a central tool shed. Their rear faces are painted like different flowers. Workers exchange failing discs on two-wheeled barrows while a few healthy ones tilt and reveal both faces.

name: The Mirror Stairwell
prompt: Build a descending squared spiral of angled mirrors around a dark working court. Sunlight skips down each flight to a glowing copper kettle at the bottom. One visitor crosses a narrow shaded landing between the bright reflected steps.

name: The Power Quilt
prompt: Stitch flexible indigo photovoltaic strips into irregular patches of ochre sailcloth. Pull the resulting canopy over a working laundry with pulley ropes. A seamstress cuts out a dead patch, leaving one square of brilliant sun on the washing below.

name: The Solar Gong
prompt: Hang a great circular copper receiver vertically behind a crescent of low silver reflectors. The focused heat drives a small piston that strikes the receiver. Sunbathers lounge on cushions outside the concentrated light and feel the noon note.

name: The Afternoon Orchard
prompt: Arrange ranks of black solar blades above rows of red-leaf vegetables. A handwheel turns the blades edge-on to pass a wave of sunlight down the crop. A trail of newly illuminated crimson leaves makes the timing visible.
